core_obligations: Set up the two families (proof lines 10622-10631): consider F |-> L_n(F) from abelian presheaves to abelian sheaves; since for each V the functors H_n(C_V, -) form a delta functor, so do the L_n, and the goal is to show they form a universal delta functor; to this end one constructs presheaves on which they vanish.

Compute the effacing presheaves (proof lines 10633-10660): for U' in C let F_{U'} = j^{PAb}_{U'!}Z_{U'}, whose value on U is the direct sum of copies of Z indexed by Mor(U, U'); using the fibred structure, its restriction to the fibre C_V decomposes as the direct sum over h : V -> V' of j_{h^*U'!}Z_{h^*U'}, and those localisation-by-zero presheaves have vanishing higher homology, so L_n(F_{U'}) = 0 for n > 0.

Universality (proof lines 10661-10670): every abelian presheaf is a quotient of one with vanishing higher L_n, and since L_n(F) = L_n(F^#) the same holds for sheaves, so the family L_n is a universal delta functor by the effacement criterion.

Identify with the derived functors (proof lines 10671-10675): the two families agree in degree zero by the computation of pi_!, and universality plus uniqueness of universal delta functors together with the comparison of a right derived functor with a delta functor gives L_n pi_! = L_n for all n.
proof_roadmap: Observe that both families are delta functors and reduce to universality of the explicit one.
Exhibit effacing presheaves via localisation-by-zero sheaves with vanishing higher homology.
Conclude universality and identify with the derived lower shriek by the degree zero agreement and uniqueness.
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the higher derived lower shriek along a fibred category with the explicitly constructed functors of the preceding lemma (statement lines 10614-10621). The proof (proof lines 10623-10675) shows that both families are delta functors, exhibits effacing presheaves built from localisation-by-zero sheaves whose higher homology vanishes, concludes universality by the effacement criterion, and finishes by the agreement in degree zero together with uniqueness of universal delta functors. H2: an effaceability construction plus one uniqueness argument, both written out.
